target.statement: Qwen2.5-7B + DAPO-Silhouette achieves 18.1 avg@256 on AIME24, improving over DAPO's 12.2, validating the Silhouette-Aware Reweighting contribution.
target.table_ref: Table 1, Qwen Family, row '+ DAPO-Silhouette', column AIME24

compute.basis: The target is a full DAPO RLVR training run on Qwen2.5-7B using 8 NVIDIA H800 GPUs, batch size 512, 16 rollouts per prompt, and 200 steps; this cannot be run on an 8-core/16GB laptop CPU.

blockers: requires 8 NVIDIA H800 GPUs for training
no code or training checkpoints released
RLVR training of 7B/8B models is far beyond laptop CPU capability
generation/evaluation protocols require large-scale sampling (e.g., K=256 on AIME)
title: Distributional Clarity: The Hidden Driver of RL-Friendliness in Large Language Models
